meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能用浏览器替你做这些事：打开网页、点击和输入、填表、截图、提取信息、测试网页应用。
howto.when: 当你让Claude打开网页、填写表单、截图等操作浏览器时，它会接管并执行。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截一张图。
say.note: Claude会打开浏览器操作并返回截图。

say.text: 在登录页输入邮箱和密码，然后点提交。
say.note: Claude会填充表单并点击提交按钮。

say.text: 告诉我这个页面有多少个链接。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can operate a browser for you: open pages, click, type, fill forms, take screenshots, extract information, and test web apps.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to open a webpage, fill a form, take a screenshot, or do other browser tasks, it takes over the browser and executes them.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the browser and return the screenshot.

say_en.text: Enter email and password on the login page and submit.
say_en.note: Claude fills the form and clicks submit.

say_en.text: Tell me how many links are on this page.
say_en.note: Claude counts and reports the number.
